judge_edits.why: Reader [5]: the 05 form stacked two relative clauses and was hard to parse. „Herstellerfamilien“ says 'the families who make it' in one word, with no Weber and only the original relative clause.

The source is 'Bisht-making workshops'. 05 dropped the making. „Bischt-Herstellung“ restores it, so the heading says what the workshop teaches. The unexplained word „Bischt“ is out of scope: the event page glosses it elsewhere.

rulings.text: Craft name „Hasawi-Nadelarbeit“ is kept. It is the direct German for the source's own term 'Hasawi needlework', and in all three places the next words („die Feinheit ihrer Handstickerei mit Zari-Fäden“) say it is embroidery. The reader answered (a) correctly, so the vagueness flag is rejected. „Hasawi-Stickerei“ was weighed and rejected: it would make the following „ihrer Handstickerei“ tautological in three sentences outside this batch's minimal edit.
Embroidery verbs: „handgestickt“ (crafts description), „von Hand bestickt“ (stores). No Weberei/Weber-/gewebt on the Bischt. Palm-leaf craft untouched.
Cave: „Zuflucht vor der Sommerhitze“ (05) stands. Winter warmth kept (C16).
